description: This Java class 'ArtworkLoader' loads and caches media artwork images, providing methods for retrieving, cropping, and managing artwork images asynchronously.

classes.name: ArtworkLoader
classes.description: Main class responsible for loading, caching, and managing media artwork images.

classes.name: ArtworkLoader.Callback
classes.description: Interface for callback to notify when artwork has been loaded.

classes.name: ArtworkLoader.DownloadArtworkThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread to handle asynchronous artwork downloading.

methods.name: getOrLoadArtwork
methods.description: Returns cached artwork if available; otherwise initiates download.

methods.name: getBestFitImage
methods.description: Selects the media image that best matches the display size.

methods.name: parseImageSize
methods.description: Parses the size string of a MediaImage into a Size object.

methods.name: cropTo16x9
methods.description: Crops a Bitmap to a 16:9 aspect ratio.

methods.name: onDownloadFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of artwork download, updates cache, and triggers callback.
